title: A counterexample to Vaught's Conjecture for $L_{ω_1,ω}$
summary: We construct a sentence of $L_{ω_1,ω}$ having exactly $\aleph_1$ many countable models up to isomorphism, but no perfect set of non-isomorphic models. This disproves Vaught's conjecture for infinitary logic. The construction follows a framework devised by Robin Knight, and the proof has been formally verified in Lean.
